annotations.title: Review shared factors and correlation noise

description: Analyze shared correlation structure and rolling concentration in a caller-defined comparable panel. Use for research on shared movements across at least two series; choose market_assessment for individual move/freshness review, or dyson_reference for a wholly synthetic illustration. Prices become log returns, returns stay returns, other kinds become first differences. Both interval endpoints must align; no interpolation or silent removal of rejected series occurs. Default windows need 60 aligned intervals (at least 61 original readings per series), and window_points must exceed the series count. Returns status, reasons, source/coverage records, alignment, windows, latest and dynamics. Assessed windows contain dimensionless correlation/eigenvalues, leading_variance_share (fraction), effective_rank, iid reference edges and an experimental shrinkage candidate. Stale, restricted, gapped or constant panels can return insufficient_visibility; invalid ids/timestamps are errors. Reference outliers are review candidates, not certified factors, significance, alpha or a covariance forecast.

as_of.description: UTC cutoff for freshness and availability, for example 2026-01-01T12:00:00Z. Caller timestamps do not certify historical as-published vintages.

policy.description: Optional rolling-window sizes; omitted fields default to 60 intervals, 20-interval steps and at most 4 windows.

max_windows.description: Maximum recent complete windows returned, in chronological order; default 4. Fewer are returned when only a shorter eligible history is available.

step_points.description: Step back in aligned intervals between window endpoints; default 20. Overlapping windows are descriptive and not independent tests.

window_points.description: Aligned transformed intervals per correlation window; default 60. Must exceed the supplied series count; needs at least window_points + 1 original observations per series, including returns.

series.description: Caller-defined comparable panel, normally 2–32 series with unique ids. All members must pass source and clock gates. Both endpoints of each interval must align; rejected members are never silently removed.

group.description: Optional caller-defined grouping label for review queues; defaults to this series id. It does not certify independence or comparability.

id.description: Unique series identifier within this request, used in results and cross-series relationships.

kind.description: Measurement type. Both assessment tools convert price to log returns. market_assessment keeps other values unchanged; spectral_assessment keeps return values and first-differences level, spread, rate and count.

max_age_seconds.description: Maximum allowed age in seconds of the last observation relative to as_of. Older data remains insufficient_visibility; choose an appropriate cadence-specific limit.

max_gap_seconds.description: Optional largest allowed time gap in seconds between observations. A larger gap restarts the contiguous tail. If omitted, calendar gap policy is unknown and a warning is returned.

observations.description: Zero to 2048 observations in strictly increasing UTC order. Empty or inadequate histories return visibility gaps; null values and declared time gaps are preserved, never interpolated.

available_at.description: UTC time the observation became available to the caller. A time before observed_at becomes an availability_precedes_observation visibility gap; after as_of becomes not_yet_available. Omission is retained as incomplete availability history.

observed_at.description: Time represented by this observation, in UTC. Timestamps within a series must be unique and strictly increasing.

sample_size.description: Positive measurement-coverage denominator for this observation, or null when missing. This is not trading volume. Omit if coverage is not supplied; zero is invalid.

value.description: Finite measurement in the declared series unit. Prices must be positive and counts nonnegative. Use null for missing data; it breaks the contiguous analysis window and is never filled.

source.description: Source identity, optional attribution URL and declared usage rights. All are caller-supplied, not attestations.

id.description: Caller-defined source identifier retained in results, for example synthetic-demo or a licensed provider name.

rights.description: Caller's source-use declaration. Only permitted permits numerical assessment; unknown and restricted remain explicit visibility gaps. The server does not grant or verify rights.

url.description: Optional source or evidence URL retained for attribution; no URL is fetched or independently verified.

unit.description: Consistent measurement unit for all observations, for example USD, decimal_return, basis_points or count. No currency conversion, percent conversion or economic comparability is inferred.

filled_points.description: Always zero; data are never filled.

unmatched_intervals.description: Union intervals absent from at least one member.

complete_for_supplied_series.description: All returned windows assessed for the entire supplied panel.

dynamics.description: Only pairs of assessed windows are compared.

leading_variance_share_change.description: Current minus previous leading variance share.

anyOf.description: Squared overlap; null when the leading mode is degenerate.

leading_vector_squared_overlap.description: Squared overlap; null when the leading mode is degenerate. Null means unavailable or not applicable, never zero.

participation_ratio.description: Squared trace divided by sum of squared eigenvalues.

reference.description: Idealized reference, not evidence of alpha or certified factors.

q.description: Series count divided by sample degrees of freedom.
